discover_prompt_initializers: discover prompt initializers from litellm integrations and return a mapping of integration names to initializer functions
initialize_prompt: initialize a prompt spec with a prompt integration and register it in the in-memory prompt registry
get_prompt_by_id: get a prompt spec from the in-memory prompt registry by its prompt id
get_prompt_callback_by_id: get the custom prompt management callback from the in-memory prompt registry by its prompt id
delete_prompts_by_base_id: delete all prompts matching a given base prompt id from the in-memory prompt registry
